title: prudential_challange
summary: A personal project implementing a customer cross-sell/upsell product recommendation pipeline for an insurance business, combining rule-based and LLM-based data augmentation with downstream LightGBM modeling and fairness checks. Its L1_DataGeneration notebook uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer with conditional sampling and rdt transformers to synthesize additional insurance customer records for training.
evidence: L1_DataGeneration.ipynb: 'from sdv.single_table import GaussianCopulaSynthesizer' then 'synthesizer = GaussianCopulaSynthesizer(metadata)'
